messages.subject: Removals of dependent telemetered individuals
parts:
Hello,

If I have a dependent telemetered individual that dies from a predation incident (ie not in a trap), how do I list it in the edf? Do I have to assign it to a specific trap in addition to listing the removal occasion or can I leave the tapID as NULL?


Best,

David

messages.author: 58a62321f08f30f8
messages.subject: RE: [oscr] Removals of dependent telemetered individuals
parts:
Hi David,

 

Once you make the scrFrame, take a look at the indCovs object (e.g., head(scrFrame$indCovs[[1]])). That identifies the last occasion each individual (rows are individuals) was available for capture. So, known mortalities can be added using that.

 

Chris
